data.name: Cavalier
data.description: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses cavalier as his secondary class gains the following secondary class features.

raw_tokens.value: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses cavalier as his secondary class gains the following secondary class features.
&nl;Order: At 1st level, he chooses an order. He must follow the edicts of his order.

&nl;Challenge: At 3rd level, he gains the ability to issue a challenge as a cavalier of his character level - 2 once per day. He adds the appropriate order adjustment to his challenge based on the order he selected.
&nl;Order Ability: At 7th level, he gains the 2nd-level ability of his chosen order, treating his character level as his effective cavalier level.
&nl;Tactician: At 11th level, he gains the tactician class feature, treating his character level as his effective cavalier level.
&nl;Greater Order Ability: At 15th level, he gains the 8th-level ability of his chosen order, treating his character level as his effective cavalier level.
&nl;Greater Tactician: At 19th level, he gains the greater tactician class feature, treating his character level as his effective cavalier level.
